findings.description: The admission rule abstraction is cleanly relocated to roadmap-runtime/scripts/readiness.py as a single authority, allowing autopilot-roadmap and resolve_readiness.py to import it without module name collisions.
findings.resolution: Accept design D1 and tasks 1.1-1.2 as specified.

findings.description: Checkpoint terminal state (completed_items and failed_items) remains authoritative over roadmap definition status without consulting advisory artifacts (learnings, handoffs, queue state), mtimes, or timestamps.
findings.resolution: Accept design D2/D3 and spec scenarios for checkpoint precedence and determinism.

findings.description: Typed external_depends_on edges require effective completion in the referenced workspace, and invalid or identity-mismatched checkpoints fail closed by withholding readiness entries and emitting bounded diagnostics.
findings.resolution: Accept design D2 and spec requirement Checkpoint-Authoritative Cross-Roadmap Edges.

findings.description: The readiness result contract defines deterministic SHA-256 source_fingerprint generation, top-level stale boolean, and sorted diagnostic items including checkpoint_absent for valid first-run workspaces.
findings.resolution: Accept design D3 and readiness-result.schema.json contract definition.

findings.description: Global ordering by (priority, roadmap_id, item_id) is established for flat output while supervise cycle_state.py retains a grouped compatibility view over canonical resolver output.
findings.resolution: Accept design D4 and task 2.3 delegation model.

findings.description: The plan artifacts, tasks, single sequential work package wp-readiness-runtime, file lock set, dependency commit 39cb6a3e87f591d488f52f0e04563406df21584b, and validation commands are coherent and pass strict schema validation.
findings.resolution: Accept work-packages.yaml and tasks.md execution structure.
